shots.brief: Selfie, arm out, walking outdoors in sun on an ordinary street. Calm, slightly reflective face.
Looking up at the sky / a roof or structure overhead, low angle, bright blue sky. Literal 'roof over my head'.
Selfie or tripod at a table eating a simple meal from a bowl or plate, spoon to mouth.
Group of friends or family posing together, waving or arm up, outdoors, happy.
At the gym or doing something physical, full body visible, mirror selfie or tripod.
Big genuine smile to camera, selfie, outdoors in nice light. Warm ending.
